text: and he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son: and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

title: II Samuel 21:14
text: And they buried the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was entreated for the land.

title: II Samuel 21:15
text: And the Philistines had war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines. And David waxed faint;

title: II Samuel 21:16
text: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred [shekels] of brass in weight, he being girded with a new [sword], thought to have slain David.

title: II Samuel 21:17
text: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succored him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the lamp of Israel.

title: II Samuel 21:18
text: And it came to pass after this, that there was again war with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.

title: II Samuel 21:19
text: And there was again war with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim the Beth-lehemite slew Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

title: II Samuel 21:20
text: And there was again war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

title: II Samuel 21:21
text: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David's brother, slew him.

title: II Samuel 21:22
text: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

title: II Samuel 22:1
text: And David spake unto Jehovah the words of this song in the day that Jehovah delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

title: II Samuel 22:2
text: and he said, Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer, even mine;

title: II Samuel 22:3
text: God, my rock, in him will I take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge; My saviour, thou savest me from violence.

title: II Samuel 22:4
text: I will call upon Jehovah, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.

title: II Samuel 22:5
text: For the waves of death compassed me; The floods of ungodliness made me afraid:

title: II Samuel 22:6
text: The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.

title: II Samuel 22:7
text: In my distress I called upon Jehovah; Yea, I called unto my God: And he heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry [came] into his ears.

title: II Samuel 22:8
text: Then the earth shook and trembled, The foundations of heaven quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.

title: II Samuel 22:9
text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.

title: II Samuel 22:10
text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And thick darkness was under his feet.

title: II Samuel 22:11
text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

title: II Samuel 22:12
text: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, Gathering of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

title: II Samuel 22:13
text: At the brightness before him Coals of fire were kindled.

title: II Samuel 22:14
text: Jehovah thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered his voice.

title: II Samuel 22:15
text: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; Lightning, and discomfited them.

title: II Samuel 22:16
text: Then the channels of the sea appeared, The foundations of the world were laid bare, By the rebuke of Jehovah, At the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

title: II Samuel 22:17
text: He sent from on high, he took me; He drew me out of many waters;

title: II Samuel 22:18
text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, From them that hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

title: II Samuel 22:19
text: They came upon me in the day of my calamity; But Jehovah was my stay.

title: II Samuel 22:20
text: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

title: II Samuel 22:21
text: Jehovah rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

title: II Samuel 22:22
text: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not wickedly departed from my God.

title: II Samuel 22:23
text: For all his ordinances were before me; And as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

title: II Samuel 22:24
text: I was also perfect toward him; And I kept myself from mine iniquity.

title: II Samuel 22:25
text: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.

title: II Samuel 22:26
text: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; With the perfect man thou wilt show thyself perfect;

title: II Samuel 22:27
text: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; And with the perverse thou wilt show thyself froward.

title: II Samuel 22:28
text: And the afflicted people thou wilt save; But thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

title: II Samuel 22:29
text: For thou art my lamp, O Jehovah; And Jehovah will lighten my darkness.

title: II Samuel 22:30
text: For by thee I run upon a troop; By my God do I leap over a wall.

title: II Samuel 22:31
text: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.

title: II Samuel 22:32
text: For who is God, save Jehovah? And who is a rock, save our God?

title: II Samuel 22:33
text: God is my strong fortress; And he guideth the perfect in his way.

title: II Samuel 22:34
text: He maketh his feet like hinds' [feet], And setteth me upon my high places.

title: II Samuel 22:35
text: He teacheth my hands to war, So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.

title: II Samuel 22:36
text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation; And thy gentleness hath made me great.

title: II Samuel 22:37
text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; And my feet have not slipped.

title: II Samuel 22:38
text: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; Neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

title: II Samuel 22:39
text: And I have consumed them, and smitten them through, so that they cannot arise: Yea, they are fallen under my feet.

title: II Samuel 22:40
text: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle; Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

title: II Samuel 22:41
text: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.

title: II Samuel 22:42
text: They looked, but there was none to save; Even unto Jehovah, but he answered them not.

title: II Samuel 22:43
text: Then did I beat them small as the dust of the earth, I did crush them as the mire of the streets, and did spread them abroad.

title: II Samuel 22:44
text: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people; Thou hast kept me to be the head of the nations: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

title: II Samuel 22:45
text: The foreigners shall submit themselves unto me: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me.

title: II Samuel 22:46
text: The foreigners shall fade away, And shall come trembling out of their close places.

title: II Samuel 22:47
text: Jehovah liveth; And blessed be my rock; And exalted be God, the rock of my salvation,

title: II Samuel 22:48
text: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And that bringeth down peoples under me,

title: II Samuel 22:49
text: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: Yea, thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.

title: II Samuel 22:50
text: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the nations, And will sing praises unto thy name.

title: II Samuel 22:51
text: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.

title: II Samuel 23:1
text: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse saith, And the man who was raised on high saith, The anointed of the God of Jacob, And the sweet psalmist of Israel:

title: II Samuel 23:2
text: The Spirit of Jehovah spake by me, And his word was upon my tongue.

title: II Samuel 23:3
text: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spake to me: One that ruleth over men righteously, That ruleth in the fear of God,

title: II Samuel 23:4
text: [He shall be] as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, A morning without clouds, [When] the tender grass [springeth] out of the earth, Through clear shining after rain.

title: II Samuel 23:5
text: Verily my house is not so with God; Yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, Ordered in all things, and sure: For it is all my salvation, and all [my] desire, Although he maketh it not to grow.

title: II Samuel 23:6
text: But the ungodly shall be all of them as thorns to be thrust away, Because they cannot be taken with the hand

title: II Samuel 23:7
text: But the man that toucheth them Must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear: And they shall be utterly burned with fire in [their] place

title: II Samuel 23:8
text: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time.

title: II Samuel 23:9
text: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away.

title: II Samuel 23:10
text: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword; and Jehovah wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take spoil.

title: II Samuel 23:11
text: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

title: II Samuel 23:12
text: But he stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and slew the Philistines; and Jehovah wrought a great victory.

title: II Samuel 23:13
text: And three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

title: II Samuel 23:14
text: And David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.

title: II Samuel 23:15
text: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!

title: II Samuel 23:16
text: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto Jehovah.

title: II Samuel 23:17
text: And he said, Be it far from me, O Jehovah, that I should do this: [shall I drink] the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.

title: II Samuel 23:18
text: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them, and had a name among the three.

title: II Samuel 23:19
text: Was he not most honorable of the three? therefore he was made their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the [first] three.

title: II Samuel 23:20
text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he slew the two [sons of] Ariel of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow.

title: II Samuel 23:21
text: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

title: II Samuel 23:22
text: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had a name among the three mighty men.

title: II Samuel 23:23
text: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he attained not to the [first] three. And David set him over his guard.

title: II Samuel 23:24
text: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

title: II Samuel 23:25
text: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

title: II Samuel 23:26
text: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

title: II Samuel 23:27
text: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

title: II Samuel 23:28
text: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

title: II Samuel 23:29
text: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

title: II Samuel 23:30
text: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

title: II Samuel 23:31
text: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

title: II Samuel 23:32
text: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

title: II Samuel 23:33
text: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

title: II Samuel 23:34
text: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

title: II Samuel 23:35
text: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

title: II Samuel 23:36
text: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

title: II Samuel 23:37
text: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armorbearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

title: II Samuel 23:38
text: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

title: II Samuel 23:39
text: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

title: II Samuel 24:1
text: And again the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them, saying, Go, number Israel and Judah.

title: II Samuel 24:2
text: And the king said to Joab the captain of the host, who was with him, Go now to and fro through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the sum of the people.

title: II Samuel 24:3
text: And Joab said unto the king, Now Jehovah thy God add unto the people, how many soever they may be, a hundredfold; and may the eyes of my lord the king see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

title: II Samuel 24:4
text: Notwithstanding, the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

title: II Samuel 24:5
text: And they passed over the Jordan, and encamped in Aroer, on the right side of the city that is in the middle of the valley of Gad, and unto Jazer:

title: II Samuel 24:6
text: then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and round about to Sidon,

title: II Samuel 24:7
text: and came to the stronghold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites; and they went out to the south of Judah, at Beer-sheba.

title: II Samuel 24:8
text: So when they had gone to and from through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

title: II Samuel 24:9
text: And Joab gave up the sum of the numbering of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

title: II Samuel 24:10
text: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto Jehovah, I have sinned greatly in that which I have done: but now, O Jehovah, put away, I beseech thee, the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

title: II Samuel 24:11
text: And when David rose up in the morning, the word of Jehovah came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,

title: II Samuel 24:12
text: Go and speak unto David, Thus saith Jehovah, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

title: II Samuel 24:13
text: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thy foes while they pursue thee? or shall there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise thee, and consider what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

title: II Samuel 24:14
text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of Jehovah; for his mercies are great; and let me not fall into the hand of man.

title: II Samuel 24:15
text: So Jehovah sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed; and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.

title: II Samuel 24:16
text: And when the angel stretched out his hand toward Jerusalem to destroy it, Jehovah repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough; now stay thy hand. And the angel of Jehovah was by the threshing-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

title: II Samuel 24:17
text: And David spake unto Jehovah when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done perversely; but these sheep, what have they done? let thy hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.

title: II Samuel 24:18
text: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto Jehovah in the threshing-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

title: II Samuel 24:19
text: And David went up according to the saying of Gad, as Jehovah commanded.

title: II Samuel 24:20
text: And Araunah looked forth, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

title: II Samuel 24:21
text: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshing-floor of thee, to build an altar unto Jehovah, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

title: II Samuel 24:22
text: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, the oxen for the burnt-offering, and the threshing instruments and the yokes of the oxen for the wood:

title: II Samuel 24:23
text: all this, O king, doth Araunah give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, Jehovah thy God accept thee.

title: II Samuel 24:24
text: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will verily buy it of thee at a price. Neither will I offer burnt-offerings unto Jehovah my God which cost me nothing. So David bought the threshing-floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

title: II Samuel 24:25
text: And David built there an altar unto Jehovah, and offered burnt-offerings and peace-offerings. So Jehovah was entreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

title: I Kings 1:1
text: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

title: I Kings 1:2
text: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and cherish him; and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

title: I Kings 1:3
text: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the borders of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

title: I Kings 1:4
text: And the damsel was very fair; and she cherished the king, and ministered to him; but the king knew her not.

title: I Kings 1:5
text: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

title: I Kings 1:6
text: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he was also a very goodly man; and he was born after Absalom.

title: I Kings 1:7
text: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.

title: I Kings 1:8
text: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men that belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

title: I Kings 1:9
text: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fatlings by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En-rogel; and he called all his brethren, the king's sons, and all the men of Judah, the king's servants:

title: I Kings 1:10
text: but Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

title: I Kings 1:11
text: Then Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

title: I Kings 1:12
text: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

title: I Kings 1:13
text: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thy handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

title: I Kings 1:14
text: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

title: I Kings 1:15
text: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite was ministering unto the king.

title: I Kings 1:16
text: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

title: I Kings 1:17
text: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by Jehovah thy God unto thy handmaid, [saying], Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

title: I Kings 1:18
text: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and thou, my lord the king, knowest it not:

title: I Kings 1:19
text: and he hath slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host; but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

title: I Kings 1:20
text: And thou, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

title: I Kings 1:21
text: Otherwise it will come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

title: I Kings 1:22
text: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.

title: I Kings 1:23
text: And they told the king, saying, Behold, Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

title: I Kings 1:24
text: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

title: I Kings 1:25
text: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fatlings and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they are eating and drinking before him, and say, [Long] live king Adonijah.

title: I Kings 1:26
text: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

title: I Kings 1:27
text: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not showed unto thy servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

title: I Kings 1:28
text: Then king David answered and said, Call to me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.

title: I Kings 1:29
text: And the king sware, and said, As Jehovah liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

title: I Kings 1:30
text: verily as I sware unto thee by Jehovah, the God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; verily so will I do this day.

title: I Kings 1:31
text: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did obeisance to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

title: I Kings 1:32
text: And king David said, Call to me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

title: I Kings 1:33
text: And the king said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

title: I Kings 1:34
text: and let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel; and blow ye the trumpet, and say, [Long] live king Solomon.

title: I Kings 1:35
text: Then ye shall come up after him, and he shall come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead; and I have appointed him to be prince over Israel and over Judah.

title: I Kings 1:36
text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: Jehovah, the God of my lord the king, say so [too].

title: I Kings 1:37
text: As Jehovah hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

title: I Kings 1:38
text: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.

title: I Kings 1:39
text: And Zadok the priest took the horn of oil out of the Tent, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, [Long] live king Solomon.

title: I Kings 1:40
text: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

title: I Kings 1:41
text: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

title: I Kings 1:42
text: While he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said, Come in; for thou art a worthy man, and bringest good tidings.

title: I Kings 1:43
text: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king:

title: I Kings 1:44
text: and the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule;

title: I Kings 1:45
text: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon; and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.

title: I Kings 1:46
text: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

title: I Kings 1:47
text: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, Thy God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne: and the king bowed himself upon the bed.

title: I Kings 1:48
text: And also thus said the king, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, who hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.

title: I Kings 1:49
text: And all the guests of Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

title: I Kings 1:50
text: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon; and he arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

title: I Kings 1:51
text: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon; for, lo, he hath laid hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me first that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

title: I Kings 1:52
text: And Solomon said, If he shall show himself a worthy man, there shall not a hair of him fall to the earth; but if wickedness be found in him, he shall die.

title: I Kings 1:53
text: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and did obeisance to king Solomon; and Solomon said unto him, Go to thy house.

title: I Kings 2:1
text: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

title: I Kings 2:2
text: I am going the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and show thyself a man;

title: I Kings 2:3
text: and keep the charge of Jehovah thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, [and] his commandments, and his ordinances, and his testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself.

title: I Kings 2:4
text: That Jehovah may establish his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

title: I Kings 2:5
text: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did unto me, even what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

title: I Kings 2:6
text: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to Sheol in peace.

title: I Kings 2:7
text: But show kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table; for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom thy brother.

title: I Kings 2:8
text: And, behold, there is with thee Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I sware to him by Jehovah, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

title: I Kings 2:9
text: Now therefore hold him not guiltless, for thou art a wise man; and thou wilt know what thou oughtest to do unto him, and thou shalt bring his hoar head down to Sheol with blood.

title: I Kings 2:10
text: And David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

title: I Kings 2:11
text: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

title: I Kings 2:12
text: And Solomon sat upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

title: I Kings 2:13
text: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

title: I Kings 2:14
text: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

title: I Kings 2:15
text: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's; for it was his from Jehovah.

title: I Kings 2:16
text: And now I ask one petition of thee; deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

title: I Kings 2:17
text: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king (for he will not say thee nay), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

title: I Kings 2:18
text: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

title: I Kings 2:19
text: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.

title: I Kings 2:20
text: Then she said, I ask one small petition of thee; deny me not. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother; for I will not deny thee.

title: I Kings 2:21
text: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

title: I Kings 2:22
text: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

title: I Kings 2:23
text: Then king Solomon sware by Jehovah, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah hath not spoken this word against his own life.

title: I Kings 2:24
text: Now therefore as Jehovah liveth, who hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me a house, as he promised, surely Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

title: I Kings 2:25
text: And king Solomon sent by Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him, so that he died.

title: I Kings 2:26
text: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord Jehovah before David my father, and because thou wast afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

title: I Kings 2:27
text: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto Jehovah, that he might fulfil the word of Jehovah, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

title: I Kings 2:28
text: And the tidings came to Joab; for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the Tent of Jehovah, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

title: I Kings 2:29
text: And it was told king Solomon, Joab is fled unto the Tent of Jehovah, and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

title: I Kings 2:30
text: And Benaiah came to the Tent of Jehovah, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

title: I Kings 2:31
text: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the blood, which Joab shed without cause, from me and from my father's house.

title: I Kings 2:32
text: And Jehovah will return his blood upon his own head, because he fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, and my father David knew it not, [to wit], Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

title: I Kings 2:33
text: So shall their blood return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but unto David, and unto his seed, and unto his house, and unto his throne, shall there be peace for ever from Jehovah.

title: I Kings 2:34
text: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

title: I Kings 2:35
text: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host; and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

title: I Kings 2:36
text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee a house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

title: I Kings 2:37
text: For on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, know thou for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.

title: I Kings 2:38
text: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

title: I Kings 2:39
text: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants are in Gath.

title: I Kings 2:40
text: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish, to seek his servants; and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

title: I Kings 2:41
text: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

title: I Kings 2:42
text: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not adjure thee by Jehovah, and protest unto thee, saying, Know for certain, that on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The saying that I have heard is good.

title: I Kings 2:43
text: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of Jehovah, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

title: I Kings 2:44
text: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thy heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore Jehovah shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head.

title: I Kings 2:45
text: But king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before Jehovah for ever.

title: I Kings 2:46
text: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out, and fell upon him, so that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

title: I Kings 3:1
text: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of Jehovah, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

title: I Kings 3:2
text: Only the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was no house built for the name of Jehovah until those days.

title: I Kings 3:3
text: And Solomon loved Jehovah, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

title: I Kings 3:4
text: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt-offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

title: I Kings 3:5
text: In Gibeon Jehovah appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

title: I Kings 3:6
text: And Solomon said, Thou hast showed unto thy servant David my father great lovingkindness, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great lovingkindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.

title: I Kings 3:7
text: And now, O Jehovah my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child; I know not how to go out or come in.

title: I Kings 3:8
text: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

title: I Kings 3:9
text: Give thy servant therefore an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this thy great people?

title: I Kings 3:10
text: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

title: I Kings 3:11
text: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life, neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies, but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern justice;

title: I Kings 3:12
text: behold, I have done according to thy word: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there hath been none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

title: I Kings 3:13
text: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches and honor, so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee, all thy days.

title: I Kings 3:14
text: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

title: I Kings 3:15
text: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream: and he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, and offered up burnt-offerings, and offered peace-offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

title: I Kings 3:16
text: Then there came two women that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

title: I Kings 3:17
text: And the one woman said, Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

title: I Kings 3:18
text: And it came to pass the third day after I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also; and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

title: I Kings 3:19
text: And this woman's child died in the night, because she lay upon it.

title: I Kings 3:20
text: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thy handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

title: I Kings 3:21
text: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead; but when I had looked at it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, whom I did bear.

title: I Kings 3:22
text: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

title: I Kings 3:23
text: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.

title: I Kings 3:24
text: And the king said, Fetch me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

title: I Kings 3:25
text: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

title: I Kings 3:26
text: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, It shall be neither mine nor thine; divide it.

title: I Kings 3:27
text: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

title: I Kings 3:28
text: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do justice.

title: I Kings 4:1
text: And king Solomon was king over all Israel.

title: I Kings 4:2
text: And these were the princes whom he had: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;

title: I Kings 4:3
text: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

title: I Kings 4:4
text: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

title: I Kings 4:5
text: and Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; and Zabud the son of Nathan was chief minister, [and] the king's friend;

title: I Kings 4:6
text: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to taskwork.

title: I Kings 4:7
text: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided victuals for the king and his household: each man had to make provision for a month in the year.

title: I Kings 4:8
text: And these are their names: Ben-hur, in the hill-country of Ephraim;

title: I Kings 4:9
text: Ben-deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan;

title: I Kings 4:10
text: Ben-hesed, in Arubboth (to him [pertained] Socoh, and all the land of Hepher);

title: I Kings 4:11
text: Ben-abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife);

title: I Kings 4:12
text: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;

title: I Kings 4:13
text: Ben-geber, in Ramoth-gilead (to him [pertained] the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; [even] to him [pertained] the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brazen bars);

title: I Kings 4:14
text: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;

title: I Kings 4:15
text: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon to wife);

title: I Kings 4:16
text: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;

title: I Kings 4:17
text: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;

title: I Kings 4:18
text: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;

title: I Kings 4:19
text: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and [he was] the only officer that was in the land.

title: I Kings 4:20
text: Judah and Israel were many as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.

title: I Kings 4:21
text: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought tribute, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

title: I Kings 4:22
text: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

title: I Kings 4:23
text: ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and a hundred sheep, besides harts, and gazelles, and roebucks, and fatted fowl.

title: I Kings 4:24
text: For he had dominion over all [the region] on this side the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side the River: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

title: I Kings 4:25
text: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig-tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.

title: I Kings 4:26
text: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

title: I Kings 4:27
text: And those officers provided victuals for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month; they let nothing be lacking.

title: I Kings 4:28
text: Barley also and straw for the horses and swift steeds brought they unto the place where [the officers] were, every man according to his charge.

title: I Kings 4:29
text: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea-shore.

title: I Kings 4:30
text: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

title: I Kings 4:31
text: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the nations round about.

title: I Kings 4:32
text: And he spake three thousand proverbs; and his songs were a thousand and five.

title: I Kings 4:33
text: And he spake of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall; he spake also of beasts, and of birds, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

title: I Kings 4:34
text: And there came of all peoples to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.

title: I Kings 5:1
text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

title: I Kings 5:2
text: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

title: I Kings 5:3
text: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build a house for the name of Jehovah his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until Jehovah put them under the soles of his feet.

title: I Kings 5:4
text: But now Jehovah my God hath given me rest on every side; there is neither adversary, nor evil occurrence.

title: I Kings 5:5
text: And, behold, I purpose to build a house for the name of Jehovah my God, as Jehovah spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build the house for my name.

title: I Kings 5:6
text: Now therefore command thou that they cut me cedar-trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants; and I will give thee hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt say: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that knoweth how to cut timber like unto the Sidonians.

title: I Kings 5:7
text: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be Jehovah this day, who hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

title: I Kings 5:8
text: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have heard [the message] which thou hast sent unto me: I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

title: I Kings 5:9
text: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea; and I will make them into rafts to go by sea unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and thou shalt receive them; and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

title: I Kings 5:10
text: So Hiram gave Solomon timber of cedar and timber of fir according to all his desire.

title: I Kings 5:11
text: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

title: I Kings 5:12
text: And Jehovah gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

title: I Kings 5:13
text: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

title: I Kings 5:14
text: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses; a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to taskwork.

title: I Kings 5:15
text: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand that were hewers in the mountains;

title: I Kings 5:16
text: besides Solomon's chief officers that were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

title: I Kings 5:17
text: And the king commanded, and they hewed out great stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with wrought stone.

title: I Kings 5:18
text: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders and the Gebalites did fashion them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.

title: I Kings 6:1
text: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of Jehovah.

title: I Kings 6:2
text: And the house which king Solomon built for Jehovah, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty [cubits], and the height thereof thirty cubits.

title: I Kings 6:3
text: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; [and] ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

title: I Kings 6:4
text: And for the house he made windows of fixed lattice-work.

title: I Kings 6:5
text: And against the wall of the house he built stories round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle; and he made side-chambers round about.

title: I Kings 6:6
text: The nethermost story was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad; for on the outside he made offsets [in the wall] of the house round about, that [the beams] should not have hold in the walls of the house.

title: I Kings 6:7
text: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready at the quarry; and there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

title: I Kings 6:8
text: The door for the middle side-chambers was in the right side of the house: and they went up by winding stairs into the middle [story], and out of the middle into the third.

title: I Kings 6:9
text: So he built the house, and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

title: I Kings 6:10
text: And he built the stories against all the house, each five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

title: I Kings 6:11
text: And the word of Jehovah came to Solomon, saying,

title: I Kings 6:12
text: Concerning this house which thou art building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute mine ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I establish my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father.

title: I Kings 6:13
text: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

title: I Kings 6:14
text: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

title: I Kings 6:15
text: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar: from the floor of the house unto the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood; and he covered the floor of the house with boards of fir.

title: I Kings 6:16
text: And he built twenty cubits on the hinder part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor unto the walls [of the ceiling]: he built [them] for it within, for an oracle, even for the most holy place.

title: I Kings 6:17
text: And the house, that is, the temple before [the oracle], was forty cubits [long].

title: I Kings 6:18
text: And there was cedar on the house within, carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

title: I Kings 6:19
text: And he prepared an oracle in the midst of the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of Jehovah.

title: I Kings 6:20
text: And within the oracle was [a space of] twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof; and he overlaid it with pure gold: and he covered the altar with cedar.

title: I Kings 6:21
text: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he drew chains of gold across before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

title: I Kings 6:22
text: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until all the house was finished: also the whole altar that belonged to the oracle he overlaid with gold.

title: I Kings 6:23
text: And in the oracle he made two cherubim of olive-wood, each ten cubits high.

title: I Kings 6:24
text: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.

title: I Kings 6:25
text: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.

title: I Kings 6:26
text: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

title: I Kings 6:27
text: And he set the cherubim within the inner house; and the wings of the cherubim were stretched forth, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

title: I Kings 6:28
text: And he overlaid the cherubim with gold.

title: I Kings 6:29
text: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers, within and without.

title: I Kings 6:30
text: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

title: I Kings 6:31
text: And for the entrance of the oracle he made doors of olive-wood: the lintel [and] door-posts were a fifth part [of the wall].

title: I Kings 6:32
text: So [he made] two doors of olive-wood; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold; and he spread the gold upon the cherubim, and upon the palm-trees.

title: I Kings 6:33
text: So also made he for the entrance of the temple door-posts of olive-wood, out of a fourth part [of the wall];

title: I Kings 6:34
text: and two doors of fir-wood: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

title: I Kings 6:35
text: And he carved [thereon] cherubim and palm-trees and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted upon the graven work.

title: I Kings 6:36
text: And he built the inner court with three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams.

title: I Kings 6:37
text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of Jehovah laid, in the month Ziv.

title: I Kings 6:38
text: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

title: I Kings 7:1
text: And Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

title: I Kings 7:2
text: For he built the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was a hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

title: I Kings 7:3
text: And it was covered with cedar above over the forty and five beams, that were upon the pillars; fifteen in a row.

title: I Kings 7:4
text: And there were beams in three rows, and window was over against window in three ranks.

title: I Kings 7:5
text: And all the doors and posts were made square with beams: and window was over against window in three ranks.

title: I Kings 7:6
text: And he made the porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits; and a porch before them; and pillars and a threshold before them.

title: I Kings 7:7
text: And he made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.

title: I Kings 7:8
text: And his house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the like work. He made also a house for Pharaoh's daughter (whom Solomon had taken to wife), like unto this porch.

title: I Kings 7:9
text: All these were of costly stones, even of hewn stone, according to measure, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside unto the great court.

title: I Kings 7:10
text: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

title: I Kings 7:11
text: And above were costly stones, even hewn stone, according to measure, and cedar-wood.

title: I Kings 7:12
text: And the great court round about had three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams; like as the inner court of the house of Jehovah, and the porch of the house.

title: I Kings 7:13
text: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

title: I Kings 7:14
text: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill, to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

title: I Kings 7:15
text: For he fashioned the two pillars of brass, eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits compassed either of them about.

title: I Kings 7:16
text: And he made two capitals of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.

title: I Kings 7:17
text: There were nets of checker-work, and wreaths of chain-work, for the capitals which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one capital, and seven for the other capital.

title: I Kings 7:18
text: So he made the pillars; and there were two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars: and so did he for the other capital.

title: I Kings 7:19
text: And the capitals that were upon the top of the pillars in the porch were of lily-work, four cubits.

title: I Kings 7:20
text: And there were capitals above also upon the two pillars, close by the belly which was beside the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred, in rows round about upon the other capital.

title: I Kings 7:21
text: And he set up the pillars at the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin; and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

title: I Kings 7:22
text: And upon the top of the pillars was lily-work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

title: I Kings 7:23
text: And he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and the height thereof was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about.

title: I Kings 7:24
text: And under the brim of it round about there were knops which did compass it, for ten cubits, compassing the sea round about: the knops were in two rows, cast when it was cast.

title: I Kings 7:25
text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set upon them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.

title: I Kings 7:26
text: And it was a handbreadth thick: and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it held two thousand baths.

title: I Kings 7:27
text: And he made the ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

title: I Kings 7:28
text: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had panels; and there were panels between the ledges;

title: I Kings 7:29
text: and on the panels that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and upon the ledges there was a pedestal above; and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.

title: I Kings 7:30
text: And every base had four brazen wheels, and axles of brass; and the four feet thereof had undersetters: beneath the laver were the undersetters molten, with wreaths at the side of each.

title: I Kings 7:31
text: And the mouth of it within the capital and above was a cubit: and the mouth thereof was round after the work of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and also upon the mouth of it were gravings, and their panels were foursquare, not round.

title: I Kings 7:32
text: And the four wheels were underneath the panels; and the axletrees of the wheels were in the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

title: I Kings 7:33
text: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their felloes, and their spokes, and their naves, were all molten.

title: I Kings 7:34
text: And there were four undersetters at the four corners of each base: the undersetters thereof were of the base itself.

title: I Kings 7:35
text: And in the top of the base was there a round compass half a cubit high; and on the top of the base the stays thereof and the panels thereof were of the same.

title: I Kings 7:36
text: And on the plates of the stays thereof, and on the panels thereof, he graved cherubim, lions, and palm-trees, according to the space of each, with wreaths round about.

title: I Kings 7:37
text: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one form.

title: I Kings 7:38
text: And he made ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths; and every laver was four cubits; and upon very one of the ten bases one laver.

title: I Kings 7:39
text: And he set the bases, five on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward, toward the south.

title: I Kings 7:40
text: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he wrought for king Solomon in the house of Jehovah:

title: I Kings 7:41
text: the two pillars, and the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars; and the two networks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;

title: I Kings 7:42
text: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks; two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were upon the pillars;

title: I Kings 7:43
text: and the ten bases, and the ten lavers on the bases;

title: I Kings 7:44
text: and the one sea, and the twelve oxen under the sea;

title: I Kings 7:45
text: and the pots, and the shovels, and the basins: even all these vessels, which Hiram made for king Solomon, in the house of Jehovah, were of burnished brass.

title: I Kings 7:46
text: In the plain of the Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

title: I Kings 7:47
text: And Solomon left all the vessels [unweighed], because they were exceeding many: the weight of the brass could not be found out.

title: I Kings 7:48
text: And Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of Jehovah: the golden altar, and the table whereupon the showbread was, of gold;

title: I Kings 7:49
text: and the candlesticks, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, of pure gold; and the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;

title: I Kings 7:50
text: and the cups, and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the firepans, of pure gold; and the hinges, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, [to wit], of the temple, of gold.

title: I Kings 7:51
text: Thus all the work that king Solomon wrought in the house of Jehovah was finished. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated, [even] the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, and put them in the treasuries of the house of Jehovah.

title: I Kings 8:1
text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers' [houses] of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of Jehovah out of the city of David, which is Zion.

title: I Kings 8:2
text: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

title: I Kings 8:3
text: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

title: I Kings 8:4
text: And they brought up the ark of Jehovah, and the tent of meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent; even these did the priests and the Levites bring up.

title: I Kings 8:5
text: And king Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be counted nor numbered for multitude.

title: I Kings 8:6
text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of Jehovah unto its place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.

title: I Kings 8:7
text: For the cherubim spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

title: I Kings 8:8
text: And the staves were so long that the ends of the staves were seen from the holy place before the oracle; but they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

title: I Kings 8:9
text: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone which Moses put there at Horeb, when Jehovah made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

title: I Kings 8:10
text: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of Jehovah,

title: I Kings 8:11
text: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for the glory of Jehovah filled the house of Jehovah.

title: I Kings 8:12
text: Then spake Solomon, Jehovah hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

title: I Kings 8:13
text: I have surely built thee a house of habitation, a place for thee to dwell in for ever.

title: I Kings 8:14
text: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the assembly of Israel: and all the assembly of Israel stood.

title: I Kings 8:15
text: And he said, Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, who spake with his mouth unto David thy father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

title: I Kings 8:16
text: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

title: I Kings 8:17
text: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: I Kings 8:18
text: But Jehovah said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thy heart to build a house for my name, thou didst well that it was in thy heart:

title: I Kings 8:19
text: nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

title: I Kings 8:20
text: And Jehovah hath established his word that he spake; for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as Jehovah promised, and have built the house for the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel.

title: I Kings 8:21
text: And there have I set a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of Jehovah, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

title: I Kings 8:22
text: And Solomon stood before the altar of Jehovah in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven;

title: I Kings 8:23
text: and he said, O Jehovah, the God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keepest covenant and lovingkindness with thy servants, that walk before thee with all their heart;

title: I Kings 8:24
text: who hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou didst promise him: yea, thou spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thy hand, as it is this day.

title: I Kings 8:25
text: Now therefore, O Jehovah, the God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

title: I Kings 8:26
text: Now therefore, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

title: I Kings 8:27
text: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded!

title: I Kings 8:28
text: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Jehovah my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee this day;

title: I Kings 8:29
text: that thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place whereof thou hast said, My name shall be there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall pray toward this place.

title: I Kings 8:30
text: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: yea, hear thou in heaven thy dwelling-place; and when thou hearest, forgive.

title: I Kings 8:31
text: If a man sin against his neighbor, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and he come [and] swear before thine altar in this house;

title: I Kings 8:32
text: then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

title: I Kings 8:33
text: When thy people Israel are smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; if they turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication unto thee in this house:

title: I Kings 8:34
text: then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

title: I Kings 8:35
text: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them:

title: I Kings 8:36
text: then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou teachest them the good way wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

title: I Kings 8:37
text: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting [or] mildew, locust [or] caterpillar; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;

title: I Kings 8:38
text: what prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, [or] by all thy people Israel, who shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

title: I Kings 8:39
text: then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling-place, and forgive, and do, and render unto every man according to all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

title: I Kings 8:40
text: that they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

title: I Kings 8:41
text: Moreover concerning the foreigner, that is not of thy people Israel, when he shall come out of a far country for thy name's sake

title: I Kings 8:42
text: (for they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy mighty hand, and of thine outstretched arm); when he shall come and pray toward this house;

title: I Kings 8:43
text: hear thou in heaven thy dwelling-place, and do according to all that the foreigner calleth to thee for; that all the peoples of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by my name.

title: I Kings 8:44
text: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatsoever way thou shalt send them, and they pray unto Jehovah toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name;

title: I Kings 8:45
text: then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

title: I Kings 8:46
text: If they sin against thee (for there is no man that sinneth not), and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive unto the land of the enemy, far off or near;

title: I Kings 8:47
text: yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captive, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have dealt wickedly;

title: I Kings 8:48
text: if they return unto thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies, who carried them captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

title: I Kings 8:49
text: then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling-place, and maintain their cause;

title: I Kings 8:50
text: and forgive thy people who have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them

title: I Kings 8:51
text: (for they are thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron);

title: I Kings 8:52
text: that thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them whensoever they cry unto thee.

title: I Kings 8:53
text: For thou didst separate them from among all the peoples of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord Jehovah.

title: I Kings 8:54
text: And it was so, that, when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto Jehovah, he arose from before the altar of Jehovah, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread forth toward heaven.

title: I Kings 8:55
text: And he stood, and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

title: I Kings 8:56
text: Blessed be Jehovah, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

title: I Kings 8:57
text: Jehovah our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us;

title: I Kings 8:58
text: that he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.

title: I Kings 8:59
text: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before Jehovah, be nigh unto Jehovah our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel, as every day shall require;

title: I Kings 8:60
text: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Jehovah, he is God; there is none else.

title: I Kings 8:61
text: Let your heart therefore be perfect with Jehovah our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

title: I Kings 8:62
text: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before Jehovah.

title: I Kings 8:63
text: And Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, which he offered unto Jehovah, two and twenty thousand oxen, and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of Jehovah.

title: I Kings 8:64
text: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of Jehovah; for there he offered the burnt-offering, and the meal-offering, and the fat of the peace-offerings, because the brazen altar that was before Jehovah was too little to receive the burnt-offering, and the meal-offering, and the fat of the peace-offerings.

title: I Kings 8:65
text: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath unto the brook of Egypt, before Jehovah our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

title: I Kings 8:66
text: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that Jehovah had showed unto David his servant, and to Israel his people.

title: I Kings 9:1
text: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of Jehovah, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,

title: I Kings 9:2
text: that Jehovah appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

title: I Kings 9:3
text: And Jehovah said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

title: I Kings 9:4
